surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-reflectance dorsal surface with minimal grayscale depth, consistent with a fully depigmented adult.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; very low-contrast transitions between the primary white surface and subtle, shaded lateral contours.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A longitudinal dorsal ridge is clearly visible along the central axis of the posterior half, creating a slight topological elevation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a prominent dark punctate mark on the left side of the head and several faint, parallel linear scars (rake marks) on the lower back.
other_distinctive_markers: The highly localized dark spot on the cranial-left region serves as a unique identifying feature against the otherwise uniform white dorsal field.
